name: @formancy/code-style
description: The ESLint rules and the Prettier format the formancy repositories share: one module, which each repository calls with its own paths.
//check:pkg: publint only, as for @formancy/themes: this package ships one JavaScript module
and no types, so there is nothing for attw to resolve. Nothing here builds or
type-checks either: the module is published as it is written, byte for byte the
copy formancy.ai-health and formancy.ai-data carry until they pin this package.
//peerDependencies: The tools a repository runs, at versions it chooses, so they are peers. Each
range starts at the version this package's suite runs, which the workspace
catalog pins exactly, and the install gate installs the newest each admits: the
bound of a range is a version something ran (0134). TypeScript's is the
catalog's own range, for 0039's reason; typescript-eslint asks for it.
